versions.content: If the priority mechanism is active, the ADC module shall support a queuing of conversion requests. The conversion requsts shall be queued when, if channel group with higher priority is requested for conversion while lower priority channel group conversion is ongoing (here lower priority group shall be queued) OR channel group conversion requests can not immediately be handled, because a higher priority channel group conversion is ongoing.
